notes.trinkets: There are a great number of Trinkets available for Assassination, and we will always want to play a combination of a powerful on-use trinket like Voracious Heart of Ula'tek or Lustrous Golden Plumage , and a passive trinket providing potent secondary stat buffs or raw damage procs. Make sure to macro your on-use trinket to your Deathmark cast!
